sermon.title: Fall Festival of Fun 2025
sermon.speaker: Unidentified speaker (not clearly Pastor Kincer)
sermon.summary: At a fall festival at the Lake Elsinore outlets, a church leader calls game numbers and shares scriptures between rounds: Jesus is light in darkness, gives abundant life, makes us new, and offers eternal life. Sunday service is at 10 a.m.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

chunks.section_question: Why is the church at the festival?
chunks.short_answer: To shine Jesus’ light at the outlets—the light shines in the darkness.
chunks.text: Well, we are Vine Cluster Church right here, right next door. And we’re here in the outlets and we are here to shine Jesus’s light. In John 1:5, it says that the light shines in the darkness and darkness is not overcome it. It says in Psalm 27, “The Lord is my light and my salvation.” Jesus is that unstoppable light and nothing can put him out. Hallelujah. Okay, you guys ready?
